conviction_note: The fundamental read and the reaction read disagree and I have sized the reaction. KWS should print an FY25/26 EBITDA margin in the upper half of its own 19-21% band (9M EBITDA EUR 386.8m already exceeds the FY24/25 full-year EUR 350.5m, and prior-year Q4 EBITDA was -EUR 10.3m), so print_vs_bar is positive. But this stock's actual print-day record is six negatives out of six over two years (mean -4.93%, median |move| 4.72%), including two prints where EBITDA rose and the stock still fell, it enters +15.4% over 60 sessions and 2.6% below a 52-week high set on 2026-09-09, and the FY26/27 outlook has to lap a ~EUR 30m licensing one-off, the lost AgReliant equity income and a further Russia decline against a medium-term frame of 3-5% organic growth it already missed once in February. The German-language leg gave me one real offset (southern-German 2027 beet delivery rights restored from 90% to 100%), which is why I stop at -2.9 rather than at the name's own mean print-day move.
bar: Company guidance, reaffirmed at the 9M stage on 2026-05-12 and originally cut on 2026-02-12: FY2025/2026 net sales on a comparable basis at the previous year's level, EBITDA margin 19-21%. Sourced to the issuer via https://www.kws.com/corp/en/media-press/news/financial-results-for-the-first-nine-months-of-2025-2026-kws-remains-on-track-despite-a-challenging-agricultural-environment/ and to the German wire at https://www.4investors.de/nachrichten/boerse.php?sektion=stock&ID=188260 (12.02.2026). Medium-term frame from the FY24/25 release of 2025-09-25: organic growth 3-5%, EBITDA margin 19-21% through 2028. No consensus EPS/EBITDA line was retrievable free (finanzen.net's Schaetzungen table is JavaScript-rendered), so I sized against company guidance, not against a broker number.

positioning_check: No disclosed net short position. I re-downloaded the Bundesanzeiger Netto-Leerverkaufspositionen CSV myself on 2026-09-22 (486 position rows, latest date stamp 2026-09-21) and neither 'KWS' nor DE0007074007 appears - https://www.bundesanzeiger.de/pub/de/nlp?0--top~csv~form~panel-form-csv~resource~link . That is the 0.5% truncation floor, NOT a measurement: anything from 0.00% to 0.49% reads identically, and the baseline's anchor_covered:false / register_read_no_position says exactly this. short_change_pct_pts is 0.0 in the baseline but the German register publishes only the current snapshot, so building-vs-covering is genuinely unknown here, not flat. Consequence for sizing: this name has NO positioning anchor, priced_lean_pct (-0.175) is effectively the 20-day run-up, which is also the free control this stage must beat - so I am not able to claim my negative beats the lean by disagreeing with informed flow, only that the lean is built on a 20-day window (+3.5%) that hides a 60-day run-up of +15.4%.

findings.finding: KWS's results days are systematically sold - the last six actual print days all closed lower (2024-09-26 -0.91%, 2025-02-13 -9.49%, 2025-05-13 -6.30%, 2025-09-25 -3.13%, 2026-02-12 -7.42%, 2026-05-12 -2.31%; five of six also underperformed the SDAX) - and this year's number is NOT pre-released: KWS's own ad-hoc register carries no filing since 2025-09-24, so there is no Prognoseanpassung and no preliminary-figures ad-hoc standing between the market and the full-year number. The stock goes in at EUR 77.80, +15.4% over 60 sessions and 2.6% below a 52-week high set on 2026-09-09.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This IS the reaction history. Six of six prints negative over two years, mean -4.93%, median absolute move 4.72%. The one print that was substantially pre-released by an ad-hoc (16 August 2024 preliminary figures) produced the smallest fall, -0.91% - but even that day underperformed a +2.74% SDAX by 3.65 points. The two prints where the operating number IMPROVED (9M FY24/25 and 9M FY25/26, EBITDA +7.2%) still fell 6.30% and 2.31%. Beats on this name have been sold.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline itself is the demonstration. Its history block is basis 'estimated_from_cadence' and its eight inferred dates (2025-08-14, 2026-01-02, 2026-05-12...) mostly land on non-event days, which is why it reports a median absolute move of 2.09% and an event_move_proxy of 2.09%. The real print days are 2025-09-25, 2026-02-12 and 2026-05-12 and their absolute moves are 3.13%, 7.42% and 2.31%. If the market were positioned for this, the 2026-02-12 guidance cut would not have taken 7.42% out of the stock in one session on a name with five analysts, and the price would not be sitting within 2.6% of its 52-week high two days before an un-pre-released annual print. No broker has published on the name since 20.07.2026 (Baader, Add, target 78->85).
findings.independence: The vendor-independent confirmation that nothing has been pre-released is KWS's own newsroom, whose only item since 2026-05-12 is the 2026-09-09 conference-call notice: https://www.kws.com/corp/en/investors/financial-news/ . The reaction-day closes are computed from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/KWS.DE?range=6y&interval=1d and the index comparison from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/%5ESDAXI?range=2y&interval=1d - a different series from the ad-hoc register, so the two legs of this finding do not rest on one document, but the run-up and the reaction distribution DO share the KWS.DE tape and are therefore filed as one finding rather than two.

findings.finding: The FY2026/2027 outlook given on 23 September has to lap three things that do not repeat: a ~EUR 30m one-off from the sale of licensing rights tied to the North American corn divestiture, a EUR 7.7m participation gain from selling the AgReliant JV stakes, and the AgReliant equity income itself - on top of a Russian business KWS says is still shrinking. That is against a medium-term frame of 3-5% organic growth and a 19-21% EBITDA margin set on 2025-09-25, which KWS already missed once when it cut FY25/26 growth from ~3% to flat on 2026-02-12. Reported group EBITDA is therefore likely to be guided DOWN year on year even if the margin band is held.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guidance line is where this stock's biggest moves have come from. 2026-02-12, comparable sales guidance cut from ~3% to flat with the margin band held: -7.42%. 2025-02-13, the equivalent H1 guidance event a year earlier: -9.49%. 2025-09-25, FY24/25 results setting the 3% FY25/26 guide plus the new three-year 3-5% / 19-21% medium-term frame: -3.13%. All three negative, and the two that changed a number were the two largest.
findings.original_quote: Zur Ergebnisverbesserung trug ein positiver Einmaleffekt von rund 30 Millionen Euro aus dem Verkauf von Lizenzrechten durch KWS im Zusammenhang mit der Veraeusserung des nordamerikanischen Maisgeschaefts bei. Zusaetzlich wirkte sich ein Beteiligungsertrag von 7,7 Millionen Euro aus dem Verkauf von Anteilen an nordamerikanischen Joint Ventures positiv aus. [...] Fuer das Gesamtjahr 2025/2026 erwartet KWS nun einen Umsatz auf vergleichbarer Basis auf Vorjahresniveau und reduziert damit die bisherige Wachstumsprognose von 3 Prozent. Die Prognose fuer die EBITDA-Marge bestaetigt das Unternehmen dagegen mit einer unveraenderten Bandbreite von 19 bis 21 Prozent. | Translation: The improvement in earnings was helped by a positive one-off effect of around EUR 30 million from KWS's sale of licensing rights in connection with the divestiture of the North American corn business. In addition, a participation gain of EUR 7.7 million from the sale of stakes in North American joint ventures had a positive effect. [...] For the full year 2025/2026 KWS now expects revenue on a comparable basis at the previous year's level, reducing the previous growth forecast of 3 percent. The EBITDA margin forecast, by contrast, is confirmed with an unchanged range of 19 to 21 percent.
findings.why_not_priced: The English-language record carries the EUR 29m one-off as a line in the 9M release but not the second item - the EUR 7.7m participation gain - and nowhere joins them to the FY26/27 base. The AgReliant divestiture ad-hoc of 2025-06-27 quantified the proceeds only as 'a low three-digit million range (USD)'; there is no public number for the equity income KWS loses with it. With five analysts and no published note since 20.07.2026, nobody has walked the market through an FY26/27 EBITDA base that is roughly EUR 30m lower before a single operating assumption is made. If this were priced, the stock would not be trading 2.6% off its high into the release, and the July target raise (78->85) would have been accompanied by a cut to FY26/27 estimates.
findings.independence: The EUR 29m one-off is independently stated by the issuer in English in the 9M release, https://www.kws.com/corp/en/media-press/news/financial-results-for-the-first-nine-months-of-2025-2026-kws-remains-on-track-despite-a-challenging-agricultural-environment/ ('a positive one-time operating effect of EUR 29 million arose from the sale of licensing rights in connection with the divestiture of the North American corn business'), and the disposal itself by the ad-hoc of 2025-06-27, https://www.kws.com/corp/en/investors/notifications/ad-hoc-releases/kws-divests-stakes-in-north-american-joint-ventures-(agreliant-genetics)-and-enters-into-licensing-agreements/ . The medium-term 3-5% / 19-21% frame is from the FY24/25 release, https://www.tradingview.com/news/eqs:2507c8479094b:0-kws-closes-a-successful-fiscal-year-2024-2025-and-lays-the-foundations-for-profitable-growth/ .

findings.finding: The 2027 German sugarbeet contracting round is already settled and it came out BETTER than the two preceding years, which KWS can underwrite in its FY26/27 outlook: the SZVG - the growers' cooperative that holds the majority stake in Suedzucker - has released 100% of delivery rights for the 2027 cultivation contract, cancelling the 90% restriction imposed in spring, explicitly because of the expected fall in sugar output from the 2026 harvest. Sugarbeet is EUR 324.6m of KWS's EUR 386.8m 9M group EBITDA, and European beet seed is billed in the Jan-Mar quarter that sits inside FY26/27.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent: KWS has guided European beet acreage DOWN at each of its last three releases and the stock fell each time (-3.13%, -7.42%, -2.31%). There is no observation in the last two years of KWS guiding beet area up, so this is the first time the segment narrative could turn and the reaction is unmodelled - which is the argument for a real but bounded positive rather than a large one.
findings.original_quote: Ruebenanbau 2027: 100 % der Lieferrechte zum Anbau freigegeben. Die im Fruehjahr vorgenommene Beschraenkung der Lieferrechte auf 90 % fuer den Anbauvertrag 2027 entfaellt auf Grund des erwarteten Rueckgangs der Zuckerproduktion der Ernte 2026. | Translation: Beet cultivation 2027: 100% of delivery rights released for cultivation. The restriction of delivery rights to 90% for the 2027 cultivation contract imposed in spring is dropped because of the expected decline in sugar production from the 2026 harvest.
findings.why_not_priced: The English-language coverage of EU sugar in August and September 2026 is entirely about the PRICE and the CROP - NW European sugar at EUR 550/t on 3 September, +40% year to date, EU 2026/27 output cut to a 38-year low - and says nothing about the contracting decisions that actually set how much beet seed KWS sells. Those decisions live on a German growers' cooperative website and in the German farm press, in German, and they are the transmission mechanism. If the market had read them, the sell-side would have a published FY26/27 European beet-volume assumption, and there is no note on the name since 20.07.2026. Sized small deliberately, for three reasons the same German sources give: the SZVG decision covers southern Germany only, a fraction of KWS's global beet seed book; Nordzucker's agreed 2027 minimum price is EUR 31.00/t, below prior years; and Pfeifer & Langen has cut more than 80 growers with ~1,200 ha out of 2027 contracts altogether. This is a direct counterparty in the beet chain speaking, not KWS, so it is a hypothesis about KWS's guidance until KWS says it.
findings.independence: The opposite-signed German evidence, which is why this is +0.8 and not larger: top agrar 2026-04-23, https://www.topagrar.com/markt/news/nordzucker-senkt-rubenmindestpreis-fur-2027-20025007.html - 'liegt der vereinbarte Ruebenmindestpreis bei 31,00 EUR/t Ruebe bei einem Zuckergehalt von 18,0 % - und damit aufgrund der herausfordernden Lage am Zuckermarkt unter dem der Vorjahre', with the subscription window 7 May to 4 June 2026; and agrarheute 2026-05-21, https://www.agrarheute.com/markt/marktfruechte/schock-fuer-landwirte-pfeifer-langen-streicht-ruebenanbauvertraege-640820 - 'Mehr als 80 Betriebe mit zusammen rund 1.200 Hektar Ruebenflaeche erhalten kein neues Vertragsangebot mehr.' The same-signed independent evidence is the EU sugar balance: https://commodity-board.com/eu-sugar-braces-for-38-year-low-as-beet-crisis-lifts-prices .

findings.finding: The reported quarter should land at or above the top of the guided band. 9M FY25/26 EBITDA of EUR 386.8m already exceeds the ENTIRE FY24/25 EBITDA of EUR 350.5m; prior-year 9M EBITDA was EUR 360.8m, so FY24/25's fourth quarter ran at -EUR 10.3m of EBITDA. Repeating that seasonal Q4 puts FY25/26 EBITDA near EUR 375m on roughly EUR 1.68bn of sales - about 22% reported, and about 20.7% stripping the ~EUR 29-30m licensing one-off, i.e. the upper half of the guided 19-21%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sold both times it has happened recently. 2026-05-12: 9M EBITDA +7.2%, sales +2.6% comparable, guidance held - stock -2.31%. 2025-05-13: 9M results that the company called robust - stock -6.30%. This is precisely why the finding is sized at +0.6 and the emitted move is negative: on this name a good operating number has not bought a positive session.
findings.why_not_priced: It largely IS priced - this is arithmetic any reader of the 9M release can do, which is why it carries +0.6 and not more. It is in the set because a hunt that only lists negatives on a name whose operating trend is improving is not answering the question honestly, and because it is the reason print_vs_bar_pct is positive while expected_move_pct is not. The only genuinely unmodelled part is that the ex-one-off margin lands in the upper half rather than the middle of the band.
findings.independence: The prior-year 9M EBITDA of EUR 360.8m, which makes the Q4 derivation possible, is from a different release: https://www.kws.com/corp/en/news/kws-reports-robust-business-performance-in-the-first-nine-months-of-2024-2025 . The FY24/25 full-year EBITDA of EUR 350.5m and the 20.9% margin are from https://www.tradingview.com/news/eqs:2507c8479094b:0-kws-closes-a-successful-fiscal-year-2024-2025-and-lays-the-foundations-for-profitable-growth/ (2025-09-25, 07:00 CEST). Flagged as DERIVED: the EUR 375m FY figure is my arithmetic from three sourced company numbers, not a figure any document states.

outside_window.finding: KWS Vegetables Investor & Analyst Seminar, Andijk (NL), 29 September 2026 - six days after the print, on the one segment that is structurally loss-making (FY24/25 Vegetables EBIT -EUR 45.8m on EUR 72.1m of sales; 9M FY25/26 EBITDA -EUR 19.3m on EUR 46.5m). A restructuring, a disposal or a path-to-breakeven date would land there, not on 23 September.

Annual Shareholders' Meeting 2026 on 1 December votes the dividend. The proposal itself is announced with the results on 23 September and is inside the window, but under the payout policy adopted by ad-hoc on 2025-09-24 (raised to 25-30% of adjusted net income from 20-25%) it is close to mechanical, so it is not a surprise candidate.

baseline_tension: My net cuts the same way as the lean but for entirely different reasons: the baseline's priced_lean_pct of -0.175 is a 20-day run-up of +3.5% with a truncated-zero short register behind it, while the run-up that matters is +15.4% over 60 sessions into a 52-week high, and the baseline's event_move_proxy of 2.09% is built on cadence-estimated dates that mostly miss the real print days - the actual six print-day moves average -4.93%.
local_pass_note: ADDED a +1.3 finding that did not exist in English: SZVG has released 100% of delivery rights for the 2027 Suedzucker cultivation contract, reversing a spring 90% cap, because of the short 2026 harvest. No English source carries a 2027 beet CONTRACTING decision at all - English coverage is entirely sugar price and crop size.

DROPPED the English-pass -1.0 'the sugar recovery cannot be underwritten in the 23 September guide because 2027 contracting happens later' finding. The German farm press shows the German 2027 round is already closed - Nordzucker's subscription window ran 7 May to 4 June 2026 - so the premise was simply wrong and the finding had no mechanism left.
RE-SIZED the reaction/positioning finding from -2.2 to -2.6 by folding the separate run-up finding into it, after noticing both rested on the same KWS.DE tape.

SHARPENED the guidance finding with a German-only number: 4investors (12.02.2026) reports a EUR 7.7m Beteiligungsertrag from the AgReliant sale alongside the ~EUR 30m licensing one-off. The English releases carry only the EUR 29m item, so the FY26/27 base is ~EUR 37m of non-repeating items, not ~EUR 29m.

KILLED an unemitted capital-return idea: the same German report shows net debt of EUR 264.6m at the H1 seasonal peak and only a EUR 7.7m book gain, so the AgReliant proceeds do not support a buyback or special-dividend thesis.
CONFIRMED in German that the event and time are real (23.09.2026, 07:00 MESZ) and that no ad-hoc has been filed since 24.09.2025.
NET: impact sum moved from -4.2 to -2.7 and the emitted move from -3.0 to -2.9. The German pass made the case LESS negative, not more.
lessons_applied: 'Two findings resting on one document are one finding' - merged the -0.8 run-up finding into the -2.6 reaction-history finding, because both are derived from the same KWS.DE price series. Five findings became four; the two sizes (-2.0 and -0.8) became one at -2.6.

'A narrow proxy loses to a broad series; macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis until the company or a DIRECT COUNTERPARTY has said it' plus 'net of the rest of the company' - cut the 2027 beet-contracting finding from +1.3 to +0.8. SZVG is a direct counterparty in the beet chain, which is why it survives at all, but its decision covers southern Germany only, a fraction of KWS's global beet seed book, and two other German sources (Nordzucker's lower 2027 minimum price, Pfeifer & Langen's contract terminations) point the other way. Both counterweights are now named inside the finding rather than left out.

'Understatement is the hunters' systematic error - size on the name's own reaction distribution' - raised the emitted move from -2.2 to -2.9, past the findings sum of -2.7. The name's own print-day distribution is 6/6 negative with a mean of -4.93%, so -2.2 was smaller than anything this stock has actually done on a results day bar one pre-released print.

'Keep findings inside the exit window' - moved the 29 September Vegetables Investor Seminar out of findings and into outside_window, and added the 1 December AGM there too. Neither can pay inside a close-to-close window that ends on 23 September.

'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with' and 'a truncated zero is not a measurement' - rewrote positioning_check to say explicitly that the absent Bundesanzeiger row is the 0.5% floor, that short_change is unknown rather than flat because the German register is snapshot-only, and that with anchor_covered false the lean IS the free control, so my negative cannot claim to beat informed flow.

'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' and 'name the line a finding lands on' - every finding now carries what this stock did the last times THAT line surprised, and the reported_quarter finding records that its line has been sold twice running (-2.31%, -6.30%), which is the explicit reason print_vs_bar_pct +3.0 and expected_move_pct -2.9 disagree.
